title: diphasiastrum hastulatum
intro: Diphasiastrum hastulatum, commonly known as the forked polypody, is a species of fern in the lycopodiaceae family. This plant is known for its unique forked fronds and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The forked polypody is said to have anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce swelling and alleviate pain, and its therapeutic actions include acting as an antiseptic and a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Diphasiastrum hastulatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
